# Verify rule against demo 2: markers expand with whichever contiguous key segment contains their color.
def transform(g):
 out=[r[:] for r in g]
 row=g[-1]
 # extract contiguous nonzero runs
 runs=[]; cur=[]
 for v in row:
  if v: cur.append(v)
  elif cur: runs.append(cur); cur=[]

     a=seq.index(v)

     break
 return out
